paths.name: Public Web
paths.rule: Do not add an API unless dynamic behavior or integration requires it.

paths.name: Admin Application
paths.rule: Use Next.js instead of TanStack only when the project benefits materially from the Next ecosystem or public/private hybrid architecture.

paths.name: Python Data Application
paths.rule: Prefer a single Django+HTMX application over React+API when that is sufficient.

paths.name: Mobile Application
paths.rule: Use a Python backend instead of Hono when the backend is dominated by Python-native data, OCR or AI workloads.

paths.name: Desktop Application
paths.rule: Keep it local when a remote backend is not needed.

paths.name: Multi-App Platform
paths.composition: apps/* + packages/* inspired by T3 Turbo pattern
paths.rule: Generate only the apps actually required by the project.

paths.name: Commercial SaaS
paths.rule: Choose a full-stack opinionated SaaS base only when its infrastructure assumptions are acceptable.
